args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — combined summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a feature article and promoting a related webinar.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
